title: Embedding Tape Words
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $S$ be a state set, and let $y$ be a Boolean input word. Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $m$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, let $ho:	ext{Fin}(m)	o	ext{Fin}(k)$ be an injection, and let $q\in S$. For families of Boolean words $w$ on the $m$ tapes and $f,t$ on the $k$ tapes, suppose $t(\rho(i))=w(i)$ for every $i$ and $t(j)=f(j)$ for every $j$ outside the image of $\rho$. Then the configuration formed from the words $w$ in state $q$, with the words $f$ on tapes outside the embedded indices, all work-tape heads at cell zero, and empty output, equals the configuration formed from the words $t$ in state $q$ on input $y$, with all work-tape heads at cell zero and empty output.

Injection from $m$ tape indices to $k$ tape indices
Target agrees with local words on embedded indices
Target agrees with frame words outside the injection image
